mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, increasing phenytoin metabolism and reducing its serum concentrations, while phenytoin may induce eslicarbazepine metabolism, creating bidirectional enzyme induction.
action: Monitor phenytoin serum levels closely and adjust dosage as needed; consider alternative antiepileptic if phenytoin levels become subtherapeutic despite dose optimization.
